content: Hypolipoproteinemia arises due to genetic abnormalities or secondary to other conditions such as malnutrition, malabsorption syndromes, endocrine disorders, metabolic disorders, renal diseases, or as a result of adverse drug reactions or toxicities. Life-threatening causes of hypolipoproteinemia include conditions that, if left untreated, may lead to death or irreversible disability within 24 hours.
